title: South African President Wins Reprieve From ‘Farmgate’ Impeachment Investigation
summary_full: A court threw out a report suggesting that Cyril Ramaphosa may have tried to conceal the theft of more than half a million dollars of U.S. currency.
summary_public: A court threw out a report suggesting that Cyril Ramaphosa may have tried to conceal the theft of more than half a million dollars of U.S. currency.
